description.value: YY Sushi is a Japanese restaurant established in 2022 on Kingsway in Vancouver's East Side, offering an extensive menu of hand-rolled sushi, sashimi, nigiri, ramen, udon, and bento boxes with both dine-in and takeout available. The kitchen emphasizes daily-sourced fresh ingredients and maintains a bilingual (English/Chinese) menu reflecting the neighbourhood's diverse community. A loyalty stamp program and takeout discount make it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists passing through this busy arterial corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from yysushi.ca fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, email). The promotions page explicitly mentions takeout discounts and the menu page lists delivery platform partners (Uber Eats, DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, PikaPoints), confirming takeout service. The menu includes multiple clearly vegetarian items (Edamame, Seaweed Salad, Veggie Spring Roll, Vege Sunomono, Yam/Pumpkin Tempura, etc.), supporting a vegetarian-available value=true. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM lists a second order-specific website (website:orders: https://yysushivancouver.ca) with a different domain from the primary site (yysushi.ca); this secondary domain was not fetched and may contain additional information.
Website address string shows a formatting quirk ('1947 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC, Vancouver, BC' — 'Vancouver, BC' duplicated), though the street address itself is consistent with OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active sit-down and takeout Japanese restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor (Kingsway), recently verified open as of 2026-05-09. Offers a wide menu including vegetarian options and takeout, making it a useful food stop for touring cyclists; key cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms) are unconfirmed and should be verified on-site.
